title: Data and code for: Seasonal Activation and Drainage of a Weathered-Bedrock Groundwater System
description: Frozen manuscript inputs, three executed analysis notebooks, calibration and integration audit tables, and figure outputs for seasonal groundwater activation and drainage at Rivendell, Elder Creek, California. This release corrects serial-specific neutron-probe calibration, fixes storage integration intervals, and excludes interpolation across groundwater gaps longer than seven days.
